Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1794523, standard_relation = '=', and non-null standard_value and standard_relation. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
